title: Windows server operations
description: Catch the Windows problems that take a server or service down: unexpected reboots, full disks, failed services, slow storage, CPU and memory saturation, fatal hardware errors, and crashing applications. Uses the standard Windows add-on with Perfmon and the System log.

requiredData.notes: Enable the Perfmon CPU, Memory, and LogicalDisk inputs and the System and Application event log inputs in Splunk_TA_windows on each Universal Forwarder.

industrySources.control: Four golden signals: latency, traffic, errors, saturation
Kernel-Power event 41: unexpected restart / bug check

curationNotes: Skips role-specific DNS, DHCP, and failover-cluster UCs.
All eight sidecars are status draft; verify before publishing.
